name: civicguard-simulation

scripts.desktop:win: npm run build:web && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --publish never
scripts.desktop:mac: npm run build:web && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --publish never
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && cap open android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:sync && cap open ios

description: Wildfire alert planning simulation for desktop and mobile
